scope: Manually initiated signed Windows OTA client, cloud-focused verification; not an installed upgrade certification
channel: Newer stable releases only; test prereleases and same-version repairs are manual
trust: Embedded RSA-4096 public key, RSA-PSS/SHA-256 signed release envelope, exact repository/version/runtime/filename/size/SHA-256/release identity
lifecycle: Explicit download, explicit save/restart, normal close guards, helper only after Closed, wait for parent exit; no process kill or Windows restart
testing: Cryptographic tampering, redirect/file validation, cancellation, replay/ticket identity, headless Chinese/English/Japanese UI, save and session persistence guards
